mapper.select: SELECT g.organization_no AS organizationNo, g.organization_name AS organizationName, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORGANIZATIONMEMBER gm WHERE gm.organization_no = g.organization_no ) AS memberCount FROM ORGANIZATION g WHERE g.company_no = #{companyNo} ORDER BY g.organization_no

SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.user_name AS userName, u.email AS email, u.phonenumber AS phone, u.account_status AS status, u.PROFILEIMAGE AS profileImage, p.position_no AS positionNo, p.position_name AS positionName, r.rank_no AS rankNo, r.rank_name AS rankName, om.organization_no AS organizationNo FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN TITLE t ON u.user_no = t.user_no LEFT JOIN RANK r ON t.rank_no = r.rank_no LEFT JOIN POSITION p ON t.position_no = p.position_no LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATIONMEMBER om ON u.user_no = om.orgmember_no WHERE u.company_no = #{companyNo}
AND om.organization_no = #{organizationNo}

SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.user_name AS userName, u.email AS email, u.phonenumber AS phone, u.account_status AS status, u.workplace AS workplace, u.jobtask AS jobtask, r.rank_name AS rankName, p.position_name AS positionName, ( SELECT LISTAGG(o.organization_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.organization_no) FROM ORGANIZATION o JOIN ORGANIZATIONMEMBER om ON o.organization_no = om.organization_no WHERE om.orgmember_no = u.user_no ) AS organizationName FROM USERS u JOIN TITLE t ON u.user_no = t.user_no LEFT JOIN RANK r ON t.rank_no = r.rank_no LEFT JOIN POSITION p ON t.position_no = p.position_no WHERE u.company_no = #{companyNo} AND u.user_no = #{userNo}
SELECT user_no AS userNo, user_id AS userId, user_name AS userName, email AS email, company_no AS companyNo FROM USERS WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT rank_no AS rankNo, rank_name AS rankName, priority FROM RANK ORDER BY priority
SELECT position_no AS positionNo, position_name AS positionName, priority FROM POSITION ORDER BY priority
